# AI SEO Platform

> Plateforme d'analyse SEO en quasi temps réel : Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Core Web Vitals et recommandations IA.

Site: https://ton-domaine.com
Docs API: https://api.ton-domaine.com/docs
Contact: mejrieya384@gmail.com

## Product

AI SEO Platform aide les équipes marketing et les agences à :
- Suivre les positions et le trafic organique (GSC)
- Croiser les sessions / users / pageviews (GA4)
- Auditer les Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP)
- Détecter des quick wins (positions 4–20, CTR bas)
- Générer des recommandations IA actionnables
- Produire des rapports GSC / GA4 / Monthly SEO (PDF)

## Main features

- Auth : email/password + Google OAuth
- Sites : connexion GSC + GA4 par propriété
- Dashboard SEO (KPI, trends, insights)
- Position Tracking & Keyword Overview
- Quick Wins / Opportunities
- Site Audit (Core Web Vitals)
- AI Recommendations
- Reports builder (GSC, GA4, Monthly SEO)
- Billing / free trial

## Data sources

- Google Search Console API (clicks, impressions, position, CTR, keywords, pages)
- Google Analytics 4 Data API (sessions, users, pageviews)
- Chrome UX / lab metrics for Core Web Vitals
- Optional LLM (xAI Grok) for SEO recommendations and content tools

## Tech stack

- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts
- Backend: FastAPI (Python), SQLAlchemy async, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery
- Auth: JWT + Google OAuth
- Architecture: modular monolith

## Public pages

- / — Marketing home
- /auth/login — Login
- /auth/register — Sign up
- /dashboard — SEO dashboard (authenticated)
- /dashboard/performance — Site overview
- /dashboard/positions — Position tracking
- /dashboard/keywords — Keyword overview
- /dashboard/opportunities — Quick wins
- /dashboard/site-audit — Core Web Vitals
- /dashboard/recommendations — AI recommendations
- /dashboard/reports — Report templates
- /dashboard/sites — Manage sites
- /dashboard/billing — Plans & trial
- /dashboard/settings — Account & Google connections

## API (authenticated, Bearer JWT)

Base: https://api.ton-domaine.com

- GET  /health
- POST /auth/register
- POST /auth/login
- GET  /auth/me
- GET  /sites/
- POST /sites/
- GET  /google/accounts
- GET  /google/connect
- GET  /analytics/sites/{site_id}/report
- GET  /analytics/sites/{site_id}/gsc
- GET  /analytics/sites/{site_id}/report/cwv
- POST /analytics/import/gsc/{site_id}
- GET  /api/sites/{site_id}/recommendations

Full OpenAPI: /docs
